FN-3B8BVZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 313
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/16/2023
Senate Bill 313 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Economic and Community Affairs, and any other state entity the Department may contract with,
by an undetermined amount to commission the design, construction and placement of a replica
of the Saturn 1B Rocket at the northern most rest stop off of Interstate 65 in the state. However,
any increased obligations of the Department, or other state entity the Department may contract
with, could be offset by an undetermined amount provided that public or private gifts, grants,
donations, in-kind services, and legislative appropriations are made available to the Department.
Page 1

FN-3B8BVZ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 313
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/30/2023
Senate Bill 313 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Alabama Department
of Economic and Community Affairs, and any other state entity the Department may contract
with, by an undetermined amount to commission the design, construction and placement of a
replica of the Saturn 1B Rocket at the northern most rest stop off of Interstate 65 in the state.
However, any such increase in obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by any public or
private gifts, grants, donations, in-kind services, or legislative appropriations made available to
the Department.

FN-3B8BVZ-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 313
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/31/2023
Senate Bill 313 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would allow
the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) to distribute funds
appropriated for the repair or replacement of the Saturn 1B Rocket, based on an approved plan
for expenditure to any government or private entity
Additionally, this bill would ensure funds allocated to ADECA for the Planning Program for the
fiscal year ending September 30, 2024 are used as follows:
(a) $500,000 to West Alabama Utilities.
(b) $500,000 to Bay Minette Utilities.
(c) $500,000 to Washington County for economic development.
